name: Bloodmage: Lunge generates the Rage its tooltip names
contract: #5814 / COA-4727: Lunge 500126 reads 'Leap behind an enemy, dealing ... Physical Damage, dazing them for $/1000;s3 sec, and generating $/10;804864s1 Rage.' Its effects are a jump (42), school damage (2) and a daze (178 -> 50259); none is an energize. 804864 'Lunge' is SPELL_EFFECT_ENERGIZE, MiscValue 1 (Rage), BasePoints 149 + DieSides 1 = 150, i.e. 15 Rage, and no record or script cast it. Lunge requires Cursed Form (CasterAuraSpell 525031). Expected: a Lunge that hits raises the Bloodmage's Rage from 0 by 150 internal units (15 Rage), once per cast; before the fix it stayed at 0.
